task: Add shared-platform categories (0-3 on create/edit, 1-3 required on publish, idempotent conflict, any-of catalog filter, deletion guard) to hosted apps, mirroring assistant/workflow category behaviour.

key_reasoning.reason: Spans hosted router/request models, catalog.py (create/patch/list), publication.py (publish/unpublish), projections.py, the HostedApplications model+migration, and the platform category_service.delete_category usage-check — 6 components across two subsystems (hosted apps + shared platform category service) with new abstractions (idempotency payload enrichment, cursor_scope key, sync/async bridging).

ACs are explicit and enumerated (AC1-AC11), but the task is framed as mirroring assistant/workflow behaviour while the shared validate_category_ids silently de-dupes whereas AC3 requires refusing repeated categories — an unresolved divergence from the mirrored pattern that needs a design decision.

No exact hosted precedent: async hosted session vs sync category engine, HostedApplicationError vocabulary vs ValidationException, strict extra-forbid request models, and digest-based idempotency (today's publish payload is {}). Compounded by a database-schema change (new categories column + Alembic migration) pinned by a strict two-revision schema-parity test, outstanding-cursor invalidation once cursor_scope gains a key, and an 8-test-call-site + OpenAPI-baseline ripple on the publish signature.

Technical analysis estimates roughly 8-12 modified source files plus docs/hosted-applications/architecture.md and the OpenAPI baseline, across routers/, service/hosted_applications/, service/assistant/, rest_api/models/, repository/, and the alembic migration chain.

API (router + request models), Service (catalog/publication/projections + category_service), and DB-Persistence (HostedApplications schema + migration) — a schema change/migration crossing three layers.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped from M to L: task phrased as 'mirroring the existing assistant/workflow category behaviour' ("similar to X but different" phrasing) — hosted-specific divergences (async session, strict extra-forbid models, digest idempotency, signed cursor, dedupe-vs-refuse mismatch) are not fully resolved by the mirrored pattern.

Affected Layers bumped from L to XL: hosted_applications database schema change (new categories column + Alembic migration) pinned by a strict two-revision schema-parity test (test_hosted_migrations_follow_the_platform_head).

Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: same schema-change red flag, compounded by outstanding-cursor invalidation (adding a cursor_scope key breaks live pagination cursors) and the publish-signature ripple into 8 test call sites plus the OpenAPI snapshot.
